# Jarvis, installed by Omnia AI Intelligence (OIOS)

> Jarvis is a chief of staff for small-business owners. The owner talks to him like a person. He drafts the replies, quotes and invoices and keeps the follow-through moving. Nothing is spent, sent or deleted without the owner's approval.

## The site
- [Jarvis](https://getoios.com/): a sample day with Jarvis, the three kinds of work he does, how Omnia installs him, and the form to request a call.
- [Meet Jarvis](https://meetjarvis.getoios.com): the long version.

## What he does
- Right hand: the owner's chief of staff, by voice.
- Back office: quotes from the owner's prices, customer replies in the owner's voice, invoices with a pay link, and staff schedules.
- Follow-through: a morning brief, a closing sweep, and reminders on quiet quotes and overdue invoices on the schedule the owner sets.

## Getting set up
An Omnia partner does the install with the owner in the first month, then meets the owner once a month to build the next thing. The owner owns everything that is built.
